sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.305 of 2023 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 5(J)2/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Nighasan, District Kheri.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was stated that on 02.05.2023, the daughter of the informant went missing and was enticed away of the applicant.
Mehtab vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko And 3 ...

entities.text: Mehtab vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Lko And 3
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. In the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she had gone with the applicant initially to Lakhimpur and therefore to Lucknow and thereafter to Suratpur and from there to Chandigarh and Himanchal and stayed there together for a period of four days and physical relations were also formed.
In the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., it was stated that at Himanchal physical relations were formed in between them.
The medical on record does not corroborate the allegations.

5. Considering the fact that the applicant and the victim have stayed sufficiently for long time and have visited various places and there is nothing on record that any hue and cry was raised by the victim during the journey and the tentative age as per the FIR is seventeen years, thus considering all these facts as recorded above coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 10.05.2023, the applicant is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mehtab be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 VNP/-
